svg.title: The twelve work packages of EPITA by area, with their leaders
svg.desc: Chart with no heading of its own. It lists the twelve work packages of EPITA in four areas of three. Each work package appears with its number, its title and its leader or leaders with their organisation. Strategic instruments. 1 Project management and coordination, Toms Torims, CERN. 2 Strategic communication, outreach and sustainability, Philip Burrows, University of Oxford. 3 Co-creation with industry, Carsten Welsch, University of Liverpool. Accelerating systems. 4 Superconducting thin films for radiofrequency cavities, Oleg Malyshev, UKRI and Thomas Proslier, CEA. 5 Laser-driven acceleration, Andreas Maier, DESY. 6 Advanced radiofrequency technologies, Adolfo Velez, HZB. Magnets and beamlines. 7 Permanent magnets, Raffaella Geometrante, Kyma, the only work package led by a company, which the chart marks in copper. 8 High-temperature superconducting magnets, Ernesto De Matteis, INFN. 9 High-brightness electron injectors, Paolo Craievich and Thomas Lucas, PSI. Frontier technologies. 10 Surface treatments for niobium cavities, David Longuevergne, CNRS. 11 Additive manufacturing, Andris Ratkus, Riga Technical University and Maurizio Vedani, Politecnico di Milano. 12 Advanced materials for accelerators, Federico Carra, CERN. Source EPITA project website, Structure page.
